one_line: An early historic Pandya king of Madurai, ruling a pearl-rich Tamil court known to Ashoka and later inscriptions.

appearance.age_look: mid-30s, athletic and wiry with a disciplined warrior’s build
appearance.face: oval face with sharp jawline, medium-deep brown Tamil complexion, straight nose, strong black brows, a small tilak-like sandalwood streak on the forehead, and a calm but alert expression that often shifts into a confident, battle-ready half-smile
appearance.hair: thick black hair gathered into a high front-knotted topknot (similar to early Tamil warriors) with the rest tied back, neatly oiled; a narrow gold band circlet sits low across the forehead and a soft off-white cloth strip is knotted at the back as a headband
appearance.costume: era-accurate early historic Tamil royal attire: a knee-length off-white cotton veshti/dhoti wrapped tightly and hitched slightly above the ankles, bordered with a deep maroon stripe; upper body in a fitted short-sleeved maroon cotton tunic reaching mid-thigh, edged with simple gold woven trim; over his left shoulder runs a mustard-yellow angavastram (shawl) with a subtle check pattern, draped securely and tuckable for combat; feet in simple brown leather sandals with toe loops; jewellery limited to a pair of medium-sized plain gold ear-rings, a single flat gold torque-like neckband, and two narrow bronze bangles on his right wrist; he wears a plain brown leather belt with a simple bronze buckle at the waist to secure the dhoti and sword scabbard; overall textiles are unpatterned or minimally patterned cotton and fine local cloth, emphasizing practical royal austerity rather than heavy ornament
appearance.signature: a leaf-shaped iron sword with a slightly broadening blade (early South Indian style), about as long as his arm, housed in a plain brown leather scabbard hanging from his belt at the left hip; the hilt is wrapped in dark braided cord and capped with a simple bronze pommel, and he often rests his right hand lightly on the grip as a habitual stance

ref_desc: Nedunjeliyan of Madurai is a mid-30s athletic Tamil king with a medium-deep brown complexion, black topknot hair under a thin gold circlet and off-white headband, wearing a maroon tunic, off-white veshti with maroon border, mustard-yellow angavastram, simple gold and bronze jewellery, brown sandals, and carrying a leaf-shaped iron sword in a brown leather scabbard at his left hip in a maroon, mustard, off-white, brown, and gold palette.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character sheet of Nedunjeliyan of Madurai: a mid-30s athletic Tamil king with a medium-deep brown complexion, oval face, sharp jawline, strong brows, and a calm but alert expression that often becomes a confident half-smile. His thick black hair is oiled and gathered into a high front-knotted topknot, the rest tied back, with a narrow gold band circlet sitting low across his forehead and an off-white cloth strip knotted as a headband at the back. He wears a knee-length off-white cotton veshti/dhoti wrapped tightly with a deep maroon border, a fitted short-sleeved maroon cotton tunic to mid-thigh with simple gold trim, and a mustard-yellow angavastram (shawl) with a subtle check pattern draped over his left shoulder and across his torso. Show a plain brown leather belt with a simple bronze buckle around his waist, securing a brown leather scabbard at his left hip. His jewellery is modest: medium plain gold earrings, a single flat gold neck torque, and two narrow bronze bangles on his right wrist; his feet are in simple brown leather sandals with toe loops. His signature weapon is a leaf-shaped iron sword with a slightly broadening blade, the hilt wrapped in dark braided cord and capped with a simple bronze pommel, usually resting in the scabbard with his right hand lightly touching the grip. Use a limited palette dominated by maroon, mustard yellow, off-white, brown, and gold, and present him from multiple angles to show consistent face, hair, clothing, and sword details.
